how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for ICAR IARI Young Professional-II Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 14-08-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the ICAR IARI Young Professional-II recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to apply for the ICAR IARI Young Professional-II recruitment is 14 August 2026. Candidates must ensure their applications reach the specified email address by this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary offered for the Young Professional-II post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Young Professional-II post will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 42,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates should possess a post-graduate degree in relevant subjects or a Degree in Agricultural Science. A Master's degree in Vegetable Science/Horticulture/Genetics/Plant Breeding is desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Young Professional-II position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Young Professional-II post is 45 years. Age relaxation is applicable for SC/ST/Women and OBC candidates.

faq.question: Q5. How will the candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Young Professional-II post will be based on a walk-in-interview.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates need to apply via email for this recruitment. The complete CV and supporting documents should be mailed to the designated email address.

faq.question: Q7. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the post of Young Professional-II in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. When and where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held on 18 August 2026 at 10:00 AM onwards in the Division of Vegetable Science, ICAR Indian Agricultural Research Institute, Pusa, New Delhi.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee required?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q10. What kind of experience is preferred for this role?
faq.answer: Experience in field-based characterization, evaluation, and phenotyping of germplasm in cucurbitaceous/vegetable crops, along with computer application skills and statistical analysis knowledge, is preferred.
